name: 图片工具
description: 图片工具模块，支持查看图片信息、缩放、压缩、格式转换、旋转、裁剪、读取相册图片、查找完全重复和视觉相似图片等操作
description_en: Image tools: view info, resize, compress, convert format, rotate, crop, list and organize gallery images, find exact/visual duplicates, and detect low-quality photo candidates

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于读写图片文件、读取相册并查找重复图片
permissions.desc_en: Read and write image files, read gallery albums, and find duplicate images

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
permissions.desc: 用于读取系统相册图片（Android 13 及以上）
permissions.desc_en: Read gallery images on Android 13 and above

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于读取系统相册图片（Android 12 及以下）
permissions.desc_en: Read gallery images on Android 12 and below

apis.name: getImageInfo
apis.desc: 获取图片信息：宽高、格式、文件大小、EXIF（方向、日期、GPS 等）
apis.desc_en: Get image info: dimensions, format, file size, EXIF (orientation, date, GPS if present)
paramDesc_en: Path to the image file

apis.name: resizeImage
apis.desc: 将图片缩放到指定宽高并保存
apis.desc_en: Resize image to the given width and height and save
paramDesc: 输出路径（可选，默认在原文件名加后缀覆盖式保存）
paramDesc_en: Source path
Target width (px)
Target height (px)
Output path (optional; default adds suffix to filename)

apis.name: compressImage
apis.desc: 压缩图片以减小体积；quality 对 JPEG/WEBP 有效
apis.desc_en: Compress to reduce size; quality applies to JPEG/WEBP
paramDesc_en: Source path
Quality 1-100, default 80
Output path (optional)

apis.name: convertFormat
apis.desc: 在 PNG、JPG、WEBP 之间转换格式
apis.desc_en: Convert image between PNG, JPG, and WEBP
paramDesc_en: Source path
Target format: jpg, png, or webp
Output path (optional)

apis.name: rotateImage
paramDesc_en: Source path
Rotation: 90, 180, or 270
Output path (optional)

apis.name: cropImage
apis.desc: 按矩形区域裁剪图片（坐标相对原图）
apis.desc_en: Crop image to a rectangle (coordinates relative to original image)
paramDesc_en: Source path
Left
Top
Crop width
Crop height
Output path (optional)

apis.name: listGalleryImages
apis.desc: 读取默认相册或指定相册中的图片列表
apis.desc_en: List images from the default Camera album, all albums, a specified gallery album, or explicit selected image paths. Use album only for gallery/album requests; use imagePaths when the user selected/attached/specified images.
paramDesc: 相册名，默认 default/Camera；all 表示全部相册
可选的图片路径列表；用户选中/附加/指定图片时使用，传入后只扫描这些图片并忽略相册
paramDesc_en: Album name; default reads Camera/DCIM; use all for the whole gallery
Optional explicit image path list. When provided, scan only these selected images and ignore album.
Maximum images to return, default 100

apis.name: analyzeGalleryImages
apis.desc: 扫描相册并按截图、文档/文字图、缩略图、低分辨率图、大文件、月份和相册进行分类，帮助用户先看清照片构成再整理
apis.desc_en: Analyze and organize gallery images or explicit selected image paths by screenshots, document/text images, thumbnails, low-resolution images, large files, month, and album. Use album only for gallery/album requests; use imagePaths when the user selected/attached/specified images.
paramDesc: 相册名，建议传 all 扫描全部可见相册；也可传具体相册名
可选的图片路径列表；用户选中/附加/指定图片时使用，传入后只扫描这些图片并忽略相册
每类最多返回多少张示例图片，默认 8
paramDesc_en: Album name; use all for all visible gallery images or pass a specific album
Optional explicit image path list. When provided, scan only these selected images and ignore album.
Maximum images to scan, default 5000
Maximum example images per category, default 8
Large-file threshold in bytes, default 20 MB

apis.name: findLowQualityImages
apis.desc: 查找疑似模糊、缩略图、过小或压缩过重的照片候选，只给出整理建议，不会自动删除
apis.desc_en: Find possible blurry, thumbnail, too-small, or heavily compressed candidates in a gallery album or explicit selected image paths for manual review; never deletes automatically. Use album only for gallery/album requests; use imagePaths when the user selected/attached/specified images.
paramDesc: 相册名，建议传 all 扫描全部可见相册；也可传具体相册名
可选的图片路径列表；用户选中/附加/指定图片时使用，传入后只扫描这些图片并忽略相册
最多返回候选数量，默认 50
paramDesc_en: Album name; use all for all visible gallery images or pass a specific album
Optional explicit image path list. When provided, scan only these selected images and ignore album.
Maximum images to scan, default 5000
Maximum candidates to return, default 50

apis.name: findDuplicateImages
apis.desc: 在默认相册或指定相册中按内容哈希查找重复图片
apis.desc_en: Find exact duplicate images in the default Camera album, all albums, a specified gallery album, or explicit selected image paths by SHA-256 content hash. Use album only for gallery/album requests; use imagePaths when the user selected/attached/specified images.
paramDesc: 相册名，默认 default/Camera；all 表示全部相册
可选的图片路径列表；用户选中/附加/指定图片时使用，传入后只扫描这些图片并忽略相册
参与查重的最小文件大小，默认 1 字节
paramDesc_en: Album name; default reads Camera/DCIM; use all for the whole gallery
Optional explicit image path list. When provided, scan only these selected images and ignore album.
Maximum images to scan, default 5000
Minimum file size to compare, default 1 byte

apis.name: findSimilarImages
apis.desc: 按用户要求扫描默认相册、全部相册或指定相册，使用感知哈希、均值哈希和颜色特征查找相似照片、压缩副本和缩略图候选；只返回 image_groups 结构化富内容，模块负责分组列表、建议保留、候选标签和 deleteRecommendation，APP 负责通用文件选择、删除确认和真实删除。默认首轮会限量限时，只有 fullScan=true 才完整扫描。
apis.desc_en: Scan the default album, all albums, a named album, or explicit selected image paths as requested, using perceptual hashes, average hashes, and color profiles to find similar photos, compressed copies, and thumbnail candidates. Use album only for gallery/album requests; use imagePaths when the user selected/attached/specified images. Returns only structured image_groups rich content: the module provides grouped file lists, suggested keeps, review candidates, labels, and deleteRecommendation flags; the app provides generic file selection, delete confirmation, and deletion execution. The first pass is capped and time-limited unless fullScan=true. If no high-confidence group is found, it returns the nearest manual-review pairs. Use for requests like find similar photos, group candidates, suggest which one to keep, and do not delete yet.
paramDesc: 相册范围：默认相册/相机胶卷用 default；用户明确说全部/所有相册时用 all；也可以传具体相册名
可选的图片路径列表；用户选中/附加/指定图片时使用，传入后只扫描这些图片并忽略相册
最大扫描图片数，默认 5000；未开启 fullScan 时会保护性限制到 300 张，避免首次扫描过慢
严格视觉指纹最大汉明距离，默认 14，越小越严格
宽松候选最大汉明距离，默认 24；只作为人工复核候选，不代表可以自动删除
宽高比容差，默认 0.25；截图、裁剪图较多时可放宽到 0.35
参与比较的最短边像素，默认 32 像素
最多返回的相似分组数，默认 50
是否完整扫描，默认 false；只有用户明确要求全量扫描时才设为 true
模块内部限时，毫秒，默认 65000，用于避免超过 App 执行超时
paramDesc_en: Album name: use default for default album/camera roll, all only when the user asks for all albums, or pass a named album
Optional explicit image path list. When provided, scan only these selected images and ignore album.
Maximum images to scan, default 5000; capped to 300 unless fullScan is true to avoid slow first scans
Strict visual-hash Hamming distance, default 14; lower is stricter
Loose candidate Hamming distance, default 24; only for manual review candidates, never automatic delete decisions
Aspect ratio tolerance, default 0.25; use 0.35 for a looser scan
Minimum short edge to compare, default 32 px
Maximum groups to return, default 50; result groups are review candidates and must not be deleted automatically
Whether to run a full scan. Default false; set true only when the user explicitly asks for a full/all-album scan
Internal module time budget in milliseconds, default 65000, used to finish before the app execution timeout
